```
'use client';

import type { ComponentPropsWithRef } from 'react';
import { parseAsStringLiteral, useQueryState } from 'nuqs';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { PORTFOLIO_SECTIONS, type PortfolioSection } from '@/components/public/portfolio-sections';

export type GridItemVariant = 'about' | 'project' | 'experience' | 'contact' | 'map';

interface GridItemProps {
	variant: GridItemVariant;
}

interface GridItemShowMoreButtonProps {
	variant: Exclude<GridItemVariant, 'map'>;
}

type GridItemComponentProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'> & GridItemProps;

const VARIANT_CONFIG: Record<
	Exclude<GridItemVariant, 'map'>,
	{ section: PortfolioSection; label: string }
> = {
	about: { section: 'About me', label: '¡Conoce más de mí!' },
	contact: { section: 'Contact', label: '¡Contáctame!' },
	experience: { section: 'Experience', label: '¡Descubre mi experiencia!' },
	project: { section: 'Projects', label: '¡Descubre mis proyectos!' },
};

export function GridItemShowMoreButton({ variant }: GridItemShowMoreButtonProps) {
	const [section, setSection] = useQueryState(
		'section',
		parseAsStringLiteral(PORTFOLIO_SECTIONS),
	);
	const { section: targetSection, label } = VARIANT_CONFIG[variant];

	if (section) {
		return null;
	}

	return <Button onClick={() => setSection(targetSection)}>{label}</Button>;
}

export function GridItem({ children, className, variant, ref, ...props }: GridItemComponentProps) {
	return (
		<div ref={ref} {...props}>
			<Card
				className={cn(
					'bg-card size-full min-h-0 min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-4xl',
					className,
					{
						'text-card-foreground bg-card': variant !== 'map',
						'gap-0 p-0 py-0': variant === 'map',
						'grid-rows-[auto repeat(3, 1fr)] grid grid-cols-1 pt-0':
							variant === 'project',
					},
				)}
			>
				{children}

				{variant !== 'project' && variant !== 'map' && (
					<GridItemShowMoreButton variant={variant} />
				)}
			</Card>
		</div>
	);
}
```

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-04-13 08:22:02Z)**_

For a new prop on `PortfolioGrid`, define its interface/type in [portfolio-grid.tsx](/home/gonzalo/gonzalopozo.github.io/components/public/portfolio-grid.tsx), next to the component, unless that object type needs to be reused elsewhere.

In this case, the usual pattern should be:

```ts
interface PortfolioGridProps {
	projectCards: ReactNode[];
	newProperty: NewPropertyType;
}

interface NewPropertyType {
	// fields here
}
```

or, if the object represents a reusable domain concept:

```ts
export interface PortfolioGridSection {
	url: string;
	v: PortfolioSection | null;
	layouts?: { lg: Layout[]; md: Layout[] };
	GridItems?: ReactNode;
}
```

I would not put it in [page.tsx](/home/gonzalo/gonzalopozo.github.io/app/(public)/page.tsx). That page is the caller; it should pass data into `PortfolioGrid`, not define the component’s contract.

I also would not use a `.d.ts` file for this. `.d.ts` files are best for ambient/global types, third-party module declarations, or shared environment types. A normal component prop type is better kept local or exported from a normal `.ts`/`.tsx` module.

So the rule of thumb:

- Only used by `PortfolioGrid`: define it inside `portfolio-grid.tsx`.
- Used by multiple public portfolio components: create something like `components/public/portfolio-grid.types.ts` or add it to `portfolio-sections.ts` if it is section-specific.
- Global/ambient type: use `.d.ts`, but this is probably not that.

```
'use client';

import type { ComponentPropsWithRef } from 'react';
import { parseAsStringLiteral, useQueryState } from 'nuqs';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { PORTFOLIO_SECTIONS, type PortfolioSection } from '@/components/public/portfolio-sections';

export type GridItemVariant = 'about' | 'project' | 'experience' | 'contact' | 'map';

interface GridItemProps {
	variant: GridItemVariant;
}

interface GridItemShowMoreButtonProps {
	variant: Exclude<GridItemVariant, 'map'>;
}

type GridItemComponentProps = ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'> & GridItemProps;

const VARIANT_CONFIG: Record<
	Exclude<GridItemVariant, 'map'>,
	{ section: PortfolioSection; label: string }
> = {
	about: { section: 'About me', label: '¡Conoce más de mí!' },
	contact: { section: 'Contact', label: '¡Contáctame!' },
	experience: { section: 'Experience', label: '¡Descubre mi experiencia!' },
	project: { section: 'Projects', label: '¡Descubre mis proyectos!' },
};

export function GridItemShowMoreButton({ variant }: GridItemShowMoreButtonProps) {
	const [section, setSection] = useQueryState(
		'section',
		parseAsStringLiteral(PORTFOLIO_SECTIONS),
	);
	const { section: targetSection, label } = VARIANT_CONFIG[variant];

	if (section) {
		return null;
	}

	return <Button onClick={() => setSection(targetSection)}>{label}</Button>;
}

export function GridItem({ children, className, variant, ref, ...props }: GridItemComponentProps) {
	return (
		<div ref={ref} {...props}>
			<Card
				className={cn(
					'bg-card size-full min-h-0 min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-4xl',
					className,

						'gap-0 p-0 py-0': variant === 'map',
						'grid-rows-[auto repeat(3, 1fr)] grid grid-cols-1 pt-0':
							variant === 'project',
					},
				)}
			>
				{children}

				{variant !== 'project' && variant !== 'map' && (
					<GridItemShowMoreButton variant={variant} />
				)}
			</Card>
		</div>
	);
}
```

For this case, define and export it in [portfolio-grid.tsx](/home/gonzalo/gonzalopozo.github.io/components/public/portfolio-grid.tsx), next to `PortfolioGrid`.

Reason: if the type describes a prop of `PortfolioGrid`, the component file should own it. Then other files can import it from the same module:

```ts
export interface PortfolioGridItem {
	id: string;
	title: string;
	// ...
}

interface PortfolioGridProps {
	projectCards: ReactNode[];
	newProperty: PortfolioGridItem[];
}
```

Then elsewhere:

```ts

```

I would not put it in [page.tsx](/home/gonzalo/gonzalopozo.github.io/app/(public)/page.tsx), because `page.tsx` is a route entry point. It should compose data and components, not own reusable types.

I would also avoid a `.d.ts` file unless the type is truly ambient/global or represents shared domain data used across unrelated parts of the app. Your [lib/types.d.ts](/home/gonzalo/gonzalopozo.github.io/lib/types.d.ts) is currently holding broader domain types like `ProjectInfo`, `Skill`, `ExperienceData`, and `Settings`. A `PortfolioGrid` prop shape is more component-specific than domain-specific.

One small cleanup while you are there: `PorfolioGridProps` is misspelled. I’d rename it to `PortfolioGridProps`, and if it needs to be reused, export it too:

```ts
export interface PortfolioGridProps {
	projectCards: ReactNode[];
}
```

Rule of thumb for this repo:

- Component prop/type only: define/export beside the component.
- Shared portfolio-section constants/types: keep in files like `portfolio-sections.ts`.
- Database/domain/read-model objects: put in `lib/types.d.ts` or a dedicated `lib/types/*.ts` if it grows.
- Route-only temporary shape: keep inside `page.tsx`, but don’t export it from there.
